groups.name: observability
groups.description: Unified observability configuration for metrics, tracing, logging, and monitoring stack export.

groups.name: observability.logging
groups.description: Structured logging configuration (JSON or ECS format).

groups.name: observability.stack-export
groups.description: Monitoring stack export configuration (Grafana dashboards, Prometheus config, Docker Compose).

properties.name: observability.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable all observability features globally.

properties.name: observability.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable Prometheus metrics collection (JVM, HTTP, database).

properties.name: observability.metrics.jvm-enabled
properties.description: Enable JVM metrics: memory, GC, threads, class loader, processor.

properties.name: observability.metrics.http-enabled
properties.description: Enable HTTP request metrics with percentiles (p50, p95, p99) and SLO buckets.

properties.name: observability.metrics.database-enabled
properties.description: Enable HikariCP connection pool metrics. Requires HikariCP on classpath.

properties.name: observability.metrics.http-slo-millis
properties.description: HTTP SLO bucket boundaries in milliseconds for latency histograms.

properties.name: observability.tracing.enabled
properties.description: Enable OpenTelemetry distributed tracing. Requires opentelemetry-sdk on classpath.

properties.name: observability.tracing.otlp-endpoint
properties.description: OTLP gRPC exporter endpoint for sending traces to Jaeger, Tempo, or other backends.

properties.name: observability.tracing.sampling-probability
properties.description: Trace sampling probability (0.0 to 1.0). Use 1.0 for development, 0.1 for production.

properties.name: observability.tracing.service-name
properties.description: Service name for traces and metrics tags. Alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only.

properties.name: observability.tracing.propagation-enabled
properties.description: Enable trace context propagation via W3C Trace Context and B3 headers.

properties.name: observability.tracing.timeout-seconds
properties.description: OTLP exporter request timeout in seconds.

properties.name: observability.tracing.connect-timeout-seconds
properties.description: OTLP exporter connection timeout in seconds.

properties.name: observability.logging.json-enabled
properties.description: Enable structured logging output.

properties.name: observability.logging.format
properties.description: Structured logging format: 'json' (Logstash, default) or 'ecs' (Elastic Common Schema, Spring Boot 3.4+).

properties.name: observability.logging.include-trace-id
properties.description: Include OpenTelemetry trace ID in structured log output for correlation.

properties.name: observability.logging.include-span-id
properties.description: Include OpenTelemetry span ID in structured log output for correlation.

properties.name: observability.logging.include-mdc
properties.description: Include MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries in structured log output.

properties.name: observability.logging.level
properties.description: Default log level for observability components.

properties.name: observability.stack-export.enabled
properties.description: Enable monitoring stack export feature (REST API + auto-export).

properties.name: observability.stack-export.export-path
properties.description: Path where monitoring files are exported. Supports: relative (./), absolute (/opt/), home (~/), env vars (${VAR}).

properties.name: observability.stack-export.personalize-config
properties.description: Customize exported configs with service name, environment, and team placeholders.

properties.name: observability.stack-export.export-on-startup
properties.description: Automatically export monitoring stack when the application starts.

values.description: Logstash JSON format. Compatible with ELK stack and general log aggregation. Requires logstash-logback-encoder.
Elastic Common Schema format. Uses Spring Boot 3.4+ native structured logging. No external dependency needed.
